notes.title: The first update
notes.notes:
General

- Added achivements
- Added keyboard customization 

Gameplay

- Added new game mode "Extinction". You have to hold as many waves of enemies as possible
- Reworked gameplay. Now the main character has a mode in which he can attack enemies himself
